meta.description: R2 merged Henry's-law/detailed-balance test (Milestone C tasks 7+8): P(N+1)/P(N) = (fV/((N+1)kT)) * <exp(-dU_ins/kT)>_N, LHS from a GCMC chain's own occupancy histogram, RHS from Widom insertions into the chain's live configuration at each occupancy N (widom_chain_kernel!, Milestone B), both under the real potential.
meta.system: RUBTAK-3x3x3 + CO2 (trappe.yaml), T=298.15 K, P=500 Pa (phi=0.99997), nsys=64 replica chains, exchange_prob=0.5, step_trans=step_rot=0.3, capacity=30
meta.pressure_choice: peng_robinson_fugacity gives phi~1 at 500 Pa (does not exercise the equation of state, which R3's own ideal-gas-with-real-fugacity test covers at 5e6 Pa); a short isotherm check (200/500 Pa, run_isotherm!) confirms loading/pressure matches Milestone A's own Henry slope K_H*PASCAL within 5 combined SEM at both points, and bench/results/README.md's own 50-point isotherm on the same framework/guest shows the eventual saturation (0.0037-0.0040 guests/Pa at 100-202 Pa, falling to 0.0010-0.0016 guests/Pa by 4.9e4-1e5 Pa) several orders of magnitude above 500 Pa in pressure. f*K_H ~ 2 guests spreads occupancy visits usefully across N=0..~8.

N0_vs_milestoneA_henry.note: widom() re-run with ninsert matched to the chain's own N=0 Widom sample count (106104) gives K_H in [6.13e8, 6.38e8] over 4 seeds (individual errors 1.0e7-1.6e7), the same scale of estimator noise as K_H_chain -- the 2.4 sigma gap against the 2e6-insertion reference is consistent with K_H's known heavy-tailed, slowly-converging sampling distribution, not a discrepancy between the two routes.

perturbed_run.description: chain accepts insertions/deletions against 1.5x the true fugacity (the same position log_insertion_prefactor/log_deletion_prefactor take f in); RHS still computed from the TRUE fugacity
perturbed_run.note: N=6..8 are too sparsely visited (1182-3752 occupancy visits) for the perturbation to show up reliably; the test's own assertion restricts to N=0..5 (>=4000 visits, >=15000 Widom samples), where every point fails at z=3.5-7.4 and the median ratio recovers the injected 1.5x factor to within 0.02.
